label: Stacking list
description: A small lead line, then 2-5 short items rising one per spoken word, flush left in the brand colour (the Scale Army cut, recipe founder-selfie-punch-cards: 'that continuously improves / our hooks / our formats / our CTAs'). First on its own white card (ground 'white'); then the SAME list carries over the person as the film cuts back: cast it again on the next scene with ground 'none' and settled true, so it opens already landed and rides over the footage with a soft halo. Time each item to the word that says it (at). Full-frame -- it places itself top-left. Example: {"lead":"that continuously improves","items":[{"text":"our hooks","at":1.0},{"text":"our formats","at":1.5},{"text":"our CTAs","at":2.0}]}.

lead.label: The small line above the items

items.label: The items: strings or {text, at?} -- 1-4 words each

at.label: When the lead lands (s, default 0.15); items without their own at follow every `step` seconds

step.label: Seconds between items when they carry no at (default 0.4)

ground.label: white (default: its own card) | none (over the person, with a halo) | any CSS colour

settled.label: Open already landed (the carry-over onto the next scene)

size.label: Item size as a fraction of the frame width (default 0.08)
